title: 第1350章 出墓穴第1349章 尽在意念间
content_zh:
高山传授了盘氏族人《太初养生经》，发现他们进步神速，很快就有人修炼至守丹境界。
人比人真是气死人，这让不少医门人都很受打击。
不过转念一想，他们医门的实力也得到了提升，这也是一件好事。
盘氏的族长盘今已经和高山谈过，盘氏无论老幼会和医门共同出世，到时候只需留下少量幼年幼女避免盘氏被灭族即可。
所以说，盘氏族人等同于也加入到了医门中。
时间流逝，墓穴中的那些外来修炼者已经被除掉大半。
高山也没心思和他们继续玩下去了，就将他们全部擒住，先行捆绑看守起来。
他们进到这里已经有一段时间了，也是该出去看看了。
若是待太久待出去再发现华夏已经换了一副天地那就麻烦了。
高山临行前将关小山和他的人也带到身前。
关小山以及他的人突然出现在高山身前，他就明白了，说道:“没想到还是被你侥幸得到了。”
他也是全凭猜测，但觉得若不是高山得到了钥匙不能有这本事，看来高山所得不只是一把钥匙。
高山笑道:“没错，的确是我得到了，不过并非侥幸，是实力使然也是冥冥中注定，你要抢吗？”
关小山摇头道:“我只是来看热闹的。”
“可惜，要让你失望了，没有热闹可看了。而且，这里已经属我私有，你们可以离开了。”高山说着意念一动，关小山以及他的人都被送了出去。
高山也没有停留，带着人离开了墓穴，回到了洞口处。
关小山并没离开，见高山他们出来并不意外，只是好奇怎么一个外来修炼者都没见到。
高山知道关小山再等什么，说道:“带着你的人走吧，不用再等了，他们不会出来了。”
关小山听到这话神色一颤，揣测着高山话里的意思。
他们是都被杀了，还是被困在了洞**呢？

不过不管哪种都够耸人听闻了。
数千虫族修炼者死的死，被困的被困，那是那些外来修炼者得知这一消息会雷霆震怒吧，绝对会加速进攻，因为华夏他们相当于没了内应。
关小山审视的看了高山一眼觉得越来越有趣了，说道:“告辞了！”
说着，转身就要离开。
“等一下！”关小涵突然喊了一声。
关小山听出弟弟声音，缓缓转身。
关小涵眼神坚定的凝视着关小山，一字一句认真道:“哥，希望你记住一句话，华夏！不可欺！”
关小山听到弟弟的话身子一颤，脸上有些变色。
这几个字好像是对他的训诫。
来自弟弟的训诫！
他曾经何曾不是坚定着这样的信念？
但现在呢，他动摇了。
关小山苦笑道:“我知道了。”
说罢转身离开，很快就消失在了视线内。
content_en:
Gao Shan taught the Pan clan members the "Taichu Health Sutra" and found that they made rapid progress, and soon some people practiced to the realm of guarding the elixir.
Comparing people to each other is really irritating, and this has shocked many medical practitioners.
But on second thought, their medical sect's strength has also been improved, which is also a good thing.
Pan Jin, the patriarch of the Pan clan, has already talked with Gao Shan. The Pan clan, old and young, will be born together with the medical sect. At that time, only a few young girls will be left behind to prevent the Pan clan from being exterminated.
Therefore, the Pan clan members are equivalent to joining the medical sect.
As time passed, most of the outside cultivators in the tomb had been eliminated.
Gao Shan didn't want to play with them anymore, so he captured them all, tied them up and guarded them.
It's been a while since they've been here, and it's time to go out and take a look.
If you stay too long and go out and find that China has changed its world, it will be troublesome.
Before leaving, Gao Shan brought Guan Xiaoshan and his people with him.
When Guan Xiaoshan and his people suddenly appeared in front of Gao Shan, he understood and said, "I didn't expect that you got it by luck."
He also relied on speculation, but he felt that if Gao Shan had not obtained the key, he would not have been able to do this. It seemed that Gao Shan had gained more than just a key.
Gao Shan smiled and said: "Yes, I did get it, but it was not a fluke. It was due to strength and destiny. Do you want to snatch it?"
Guan Xiaoshan shook his head and said, "I just came to watch the fun."
"It's a pity that I have to disappoint you. There is no excitement to see. Moreover, this place is my private property. You can leave." Gao Shan said and with a thought, Guan Xiaoshan and his people were sent out.
Gao Shan did not stop and led the people out of the tomb and back to the entrance of the cave.
Guan Xiaoshan did not leave. He was not surprised to see Gao Shan and the others coming out. He was just curious as to why he didn't see any outside cultivators.
Gao Shan knew what Guan Xiaoshan was waiting for, and said, "Take your people and leave. You don't have to wait any longer, they won't come out."
Guan Xiaoshan's expression trembled when he heard this, and he speculated on the meaning of Gao Shan's words.
Were they all killed, or were they trapped in the cave?
Either way, it's shocking.
Thousands of Zerg cultivators died, and some were trapped. Those outside cultivators would be furious when they heard the news, and they would definitely speed up the attack, because China and they had no internal support.
Guan Xiaoshan looked at Gao Shan carefully and felt that it was getting more and more interesting, and said: "Farewell!"
With that said, he turned around and left.
"Wait a minute!" Guan Xiaohan suddenly shouted.
Guan Xiaoshan heard his brother's voice and turned around slowly.
Guan Xiaohan stared at Guan Xiaoshan with firm eyes and said seriously every word: "Brother, I hope you remember one sentence, China! Don't bully!"
Guan Xiaoshan trembled when he heard his brother's words, and his face changed color.
These words seemed to be a warning to him.
A warning from my brother!
Has he ever not firmly held this belief?
But now, he was shaken.
Guan Xiaoshan smiled bitterly and said, "I understand."
After saying that, he turned around and left, quickly disappearing from sight.
